description: This file defines template classes for a specialized CUDA matrix multiply-accumulate (MMA) operation with quantization, supporting different layouts and data types, including fp16, bf16, uint8, and uint4, with architecture-specific specializations.

classes.name: DqMma
classes.description: Template class implementing a quantized matrix multiply-accumulate operation with support for different data layouts and types, including specializations for column and row major interleaved B matrices, architecture-specific optimizations, and pipelined execution.

methods.name: DqMma (primary template)
methods.description: Defines the core pipelined quantized MMA operation for row-major layouts, supporting fp16/bf16 inputs and uint8/uint4 B matrices, with architecture-specific conditions.

methods.name: DqMma (specialization for column major interleave B)
methods.description: Defines the specialized pipelined quantized MMA operation for column-major interleaved B matrices, with additional static assertions and shape calculations.
